# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.8

This prerelease restores class access for teachers and assistants affected by alpha.7. It fixes report progress query errors and reduces database work for class report completion and provisioning. The class roster stays available when progress or completion information cannot load.

The login page lists OAuth providers reported by GoTrue and offers a retry when provider discovery fails. When manual linking is enabled, users can manage linked identities in Account security. Unlinking requires confirmation with the current password and a verified email sign-in that remains available.

Back up the database and apply all pending migrations in order through `1000173_oauth_link_flow_lookup.sql` after GoTrue has initialized its Auth schema. Deploy the matching frontend, API, and Presidio images tagged `2.0.0-alpha.8`. Verify configured providers in staging before enabling manual linking in production. Follow the [OAuth deployment guide](../../docs/deployment/auth-oauth-mail.md) for the callback allowlist and environment variable.

The release workflow publishes images and the GitHub prerelease. Production rollout is separate.
